title: Scientists Thought The Platypus Was A Fake
description:
When a platypus pelt and sketch reached Britain from Australia in 1798, British scientists suspected a hoax. In 1799 the first scientists to examine a preserved body judged it a fake made of several animals sewn together. But the platypus is real: a mammal that lays eggs, with a venomous spur on the hind feet of males, and an electrolocation sense it uses to find prey underwater with its eyes, ears and nostrils closed.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Platypus'.
